methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.doc:
The method which adds the {@link HttpHeaders#CACHE_CONTROL} header to the {@link HttpServletResponse} given in the parameter, if the header is not already set. Same contract as for {@code super.doFilter}, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread. See {@link OncePerRequestFilter#shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch()} for details.

Provides HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse arguments instead of the default ServletRequest and ServletResponse ones.
